method: Each engine sampled through its own single-engine endpoint (/api/search and /api/search/naive), never through /api/compare, so no ordering bias between engines is possible. Instance warmed then settled 45s. Latency read from the server-side figure in each response, excluding network. Reported as median and range over n samples rotating through several queries.
caveat: These are production figures from a CPU-throttled free tier and are NOT comparable to the JMH numbers in benchmark-data.json, which measure isolated operations in a dedicated forked JVM on developer hardware. /api/search runs the FULL pipeline (prefix + progressive fuzzy relaxation), not isolated prefix search.
